definitions.explanation: Returning to one's job or position after a period of leave, suspension, or absence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{復職|ふくしょく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She returned to work after parental leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}して→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{復職|ふくしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: Having recovered from illness, I plan to return to work next month.

examples.japanese: {復職|ふくしょく}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時短勤務|じたんきんむ}→時短勤務：18090_jitankinmu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ことになった。
examples.english: After returning to work, I'll be working reduced hours.

notes:
USAGE:
{復職|ふくしょく} is commonly used in HR and workplace contexts. It often refers to returning after ⟦{育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}→育児休暇：07143_ikujikyuuka⟧ (parental leave), {病気休暇|びょうききゅうか} (sick leave), or ⟦{休職|きゅうしょく}→休職：18305_kyuushoku⟧ (leave of absence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {復職|ふくしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to return to work)
- {復職|ふくしょく}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧ (return-to-work support)
- {復職|ふくしょく}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after returning to work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{休職|きゅうしょく}→休職：18305_kyuushoku⟧ (leave of absence from work) is the antonym. ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧ (changing jobs) means moving to a different position entirely.
